adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` the new credential-sync branch does `await fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams(...) })` with no `AbortController`/timeout handling. Callers (e.g., Google/Office365/Zoom/Webex CalendarService token refresh paths) `await` the result, so if the external sync endpoint is slow or hangs, the request processing can block indefinitely (until some external/server-level timeout), stalling user-facing operations. This behavior is introduced by the diff when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set.
